correctness.rationale: Shan-Wang's credited labeled boundary identification and Olarte-Santos's equally spaced harmonic cyclic-polytope realization together give a concrete D_n-equivariant polytope whose origin is interior by character sums and full affine span (n>=2d+2). Radial projection gives genuine equivariant homeomorphism to S(V). The C_q and D_{q,a} real invariant subspaces have dimensions 2 floor(d/q) and floor(d/q), so fixed spheres follow exactly, including zero. Rotation freeness is equivalent to gcd(j,n)=1 for j<=d, i.e. least prime divisor n>d; quotient lens weighted (1,...,d) and its odd-degree Z/n torsion follow. For d=2 every reflection is an SO(4) action fixing a circle, all local finite stabilizers act as SO(3) so S3/D_n is a closed 3-manifold. Armstrong gives trivial pi1 since reflections generate and have fixed points; Poincare yields S3. Read verifier's independent finite facet/subgroup approach; no finite test substitutes for these infinite arguments. Full Shan-Wang source remains access risk, not proof gap in displayed geometric argument.
